explication: Maxun is a web-data platform for building and running browser-based extraction robots, then retrieving and comparing their outputs. The main workflow runs from the visual dashboard through its API to server-side run orchestration and browser/workflow execution, with persisted results for later review. README-documented branches include AI extraction, scraping, crawling, search, monitoring, document parsing, schedules, and integrations. Some of those implementations were not sampled; their paths and capability links are shown where the tree or README supports them, without asserting unverified internal calls.
